grammar: v. 打包；收拾；n. 一包；一群。作动词过去式 packed；pack one's bags 表示收拾行李。
collocations: pack a suitcase; pack one's bags; a pack of cards
commonMistake: pack 的过去式和过去分词加 -ed：packed；pack up 表示收拾好。

example.english: I packed my clothes for the weekend trip.
example.chinese: 我为周末旅行收拾了衣服。

application.prompt: We need to ___ our bags before leaving for the airport. A. pack B. borrow
application.solution: A。解析：出发前把行李装好用 pack。

grammar: phr. 打包；收拾。可作及物或不及物短语；代词宾语放在 pack 与 up 之间。
collocations: pack up the books; pack it up; pack up and leave
commonMistake: 宾语是代词时说 pack it up，不说 pack up it。

example.english: We packed up our things after the picnic.
example.chinese: 野餐后我们收拾好了东西。

application.prompt: The picnic is over. Let's ___ everything and go home. A. hang up B. pack up
application.solution: B。解析：结束活动后收拾东西用 pack up。

grammar: n. 浴室；洗手间。可数，复数 bathrooms；美式英语中常指带厕所的卫生间。
collocations: use the bathroom; bathroom mirror; bathroom door
commonMistake: bathroom 的含义因地区而异；指家中某一间时用 a/the bathroom。

example.english: The bathroom is next to the bedroom.
example.chinese: 浴室在卧室旁边。

application.prompt: You want to wash your hands. You go to the ___. A. bathroom B. balcony
application.solution: A。解析：洗手间或浴室是 bathroom。

grammar: v. 把……分类；整理；n. 种类。常见结构 sort sth into groups；a sort of 表示“一种”。
collocations: sort the clothes; sort things into groups; this sort of book
commonMistake: sort 作动词时可用 sort sth by/into...；a sort of 后接名词单数。

example.english: We sorted the books into three groups.
example.chinese: 我们把书分成了三组。

application.prompt: Please ___ the postcards by country. A. invite B. sort
application.solution: B。解析：按国家把明信片分类用 sort。

grammar: n. 卧室。可数，复数 bedrooms；常用主谓结构说明方位和数量。
collocations: a small bedroom; bedroom window; go to the bedroom
commonMistake: bedroom 是可数名词；单数前需有冠词或限定词，如 my bedroom。

example.english: There are two bedrooms upstairs.
example.chinese: 楼上有两间卧室。

application.prompt: The room where people usually sleep is the ___. A. bedroom B. kitchen
application.solution: A。解析：睡觉的房间是 bedroom（卧室）。

grammar: n. 阳台。可数，复数 balconies；以辅音字母加 y 结尾，变复数时 y 变 i 加 -es。
collocations: a small balcony; sit on the balcony; balcony door
commonMistake: balcony 的复数是 balconies，不是 balconys。

example.english: They grow herbs on the sunny balcony.
example.chinese: 他们在阳光充足的阳台上种香草。

application.prompt: There are flowers on both ___. A. balconys B. balconies
application.solution: B。解析：balcony 变复数时 y 变 i 加 -es。

grammar: phr. 挂起；挂断电话。作及物短语时宾语可放中间或后面，代词必须置于 hang 与 up 之间。
collocations: hang up a coat; hang it up; hang up the phone
commonMistake: 指挂衣物时可说 hang the coat up / hang it up；挂断电话也可说 hang up。

example.english: Please hang up your coat by the door.
example.chinese: 请把外套挂在门边。

application.prompt: The phone is ringing. Please don't ___ yet. A. hang up B. sort out
application.solution: A。解析：hang up 可表示挂断电话。

grammar: v. 邀请。invite sb to do sth / invite sb to a place；名词 invitation。
collocations: invite a friend; invite sb to dinner; invite sb to join us
commonMistake: invite 后接人，再接 to do 或 to + 名词；名词形式拼作 invitation。

example.english: They invited us to have dinner with them.
example.chinese: 他们邀请我们和他们共进晚餐。

application.prompt: My cousin invited me ___ her new apartment. A. visiting B. to visit
application.solution: B。解析：invite sb to do sth 表示邀请某人做某事。

grammar: n. 客厅；起居室。可数，复数 living rooms；living 作定语表示居住、起居用途。
collocations: in the living room; living room sofa; a bright living room
commonMistake: living room 是两个词；复数通常只在中心名词 room 上加 -s。

example.english: The whole family watched a film in the living room.
example.chinese: 全家人在客厅里看电影。

application.prompt: Guests are sitting on the sofa in the ___. A. living room B. bathroom
application.solution: A。解析：会客和休息的房间是 living room。

grammar: n. 到达。常用 on/upon arrival（到达时）；arrive at a small place，arrive in a city/country。
collocations: time of arrival; on arrival; arrival at the station
commonMistake: arrival 是名词；动词 arrive 常与 at（小地点）或 in（较大地点）连用。

example.english: On arrival at the hotel, we left our bags in the room.
example.chinese: 到达旅馆后，我们把行李放在房间里。

application.prompt: ___ at the station, call me and I'll meet you. A. On arrive B. On arrival
application.solution: B。解析：介词 on 后用名词 arrival，on arrival 表示“到达时”。

grammar: adv.（用于疑问句、否定句）还；conj. 但是、然而。副词常置于句末。
collocations: not yet; have you finished yet?; small yet useful
commonMistake: yet 表示“还”时常用于疑问或否定句，通常放句末；表示“然而”时连接转折。

example.english: Have you packed your suitcase yet?
example.chinese: 你收拾好行李箱了吗？

application.prompt: I haven't received the invitation ___. A. yet B. already
application.solution: A。解析：否定句表示“还没有”常用 yet。

grammar: v. 添加；加。add A to B 表示把 A 加到 B 中；add up 表示合计。
collocations: add sugar to tea; add a name to the list; add up the numbers
commonMistake: 说“把 A 加到 B 里”用 add A to B；不要把 to 后的对象和被添加物次序颠倒。

example.english: Please add your name to the guest list.
example.chinese: 请把你的名字加到宾客名单里。

application.prompt: We need to ___ some water ___ the soup. A. add; with B. add; to
application.solution: B。解析：固定结构 add A to B 表示“把 A 加入 B”。

grammar: phr. 把某物加入/添加到另一物中。结构 add A to B；A 为新增内容，B 为接收对象。
collocations: add salt to the soup; add a point to the list; add details to a report
commonMistake: 注意语序：先说加入的东西 A，再说加入到哪里 B：add A to B。

example.english: She added a little milk to her tea.
example.chinese: 她往茶里加了一点牛奶。

application.prompt: Please add the new address ___ your contact list. A. to B. with
application.solution: A。解析：表达“把某物加入某物”用 add A to B。

grammar: phr. 去购物。go + doing 常用于休闲活动，如 go swimming；第三人称单数 goes shopping。
collocations: go shopping for clothes; go shopping with friends; go shopping downtown
commonMistake: 表示“去购物”用 go shopping，不说 go to shopping；过去式 went shopping。

example.english: My sister goes shopping with her friends on Saturdays.
example.chinese: 我姐姐每周六和朋友去购物。

application.prompt: They went ___ for food before the guests arrived. A. to shopping B. shopping
application.solution: B。解析：go shopping 是固定的 go + doing 结构。

grammar: n. 饼干。可数，复数 biscuits；英式英语通常指甜或咸的小饼干，美式英语 biscuit 常指松软面包。
collocations: a packet of biscuits; chocolate biscuits; have a biscuit
commonMistake: biscuit 是可数名词；英美用法有所不同，结合教材语境理解为“饼干”。

example.english: We bought a packet of biscuits for the train ride.
example.chinese: 我们买了一包饼干，准备坐火车时吃。

application.prompt: Would you like a ___ with your tea? A. biscuit B. luggage
application.solution: A。解析：biscuit 是可以配茶吃的饼干；luggage 不可数且意为行李。

grammar: v. 借入。borrow sth from sb；过去式 borrowed。lend sb sth / lend sth to sb 表示借出。
collocations: borrow a book from the library; borrow money from sb; borrow a pen
commonMistake: borrow 表示“借入”，lend 表示“借出”；借物来源用 from。

example.english: I borrowed a travel guide from the library.
example.chinese: 我从图书馆借了一本旅行指南。

application.prompt: Could I ___ your umbrella? It's raining outside. A. lend B. borrow
application.solution: B。解析：说话者要借入雨伞，用 borrow；lend 是借给别人。

grammar: n. 计划；方案；v. 打算；计划。plan—planned—planned；plan to do sth。
collocations: make a plan; plan a trip; plan to visit a museum
commonMistake: plan 作动词后接 to do；变过去式或现在分词时双写 n：planned/planning。

example.english: We plan to visit the old town tomorrow.
example.chinese: 我们计划明天参观古镇。

application.prompt: They ___ to stay with relatives during the holiday. A. plan B. planning
application.solution: A。解析：一般现在时中主语 they 后用动词原形 plan。

grammar: n. 宝物；财富，常作不可数或集合概念；v. 珍视；珍爱。过去式 treasured。
collocations: buried treasure; a treasure hunt; treasure the memory
commonMistake: treasure 作名词可指宝藏；作动词表示珍爱，后接名词或代词。

example.english: She treasures the letters her grandmother sent her.
example.chinese: 她很珍视祖母寄给她的信。

application.prompt: This old map may lead us to buried ___. A. arrival B. treasure
application.solution: B。解析：buried treasure 是“埋藏的宝藏”。

grammar: v. 搜寻；狩猎；n. 搜寻；狩猎。常用 hunt for sth，过去式 hunted。
collocations: hunt for a missing key; go hunting; a treasure hunt
commonMistake: 表示搜寻某物可说 hunt for sth；不要漏掉 for。

example.english: The children hunted for clues around the house.
example.chinese: 孩子们在房子周围寻找线索。

application.prompt: The police are ___ for the missing bag. A. hunting B. borrowing
application.solution: A。解析：寻找失踪的包可说 hunt for the bag。

grammar: n. 寻宝游戏。可数，复数 treasure hunts；常用 go on/do a treasure hunt。
collocations: a school treasure hunt; go on a treasure hunt; clues for a treasure hunt
commonMistake: treasure hunt 是名词短语；参加寻宝游戏可说 take part in a treasure hunt。

example.english: The children followed the clues during a treasure hunt.
example.chinese: 孩子们在寻宝游戏中跟着线索寻找宝藏。

application.prompt: Players follow clues to find a hidden prize. This game is a ___. A. movie B. treasure hunt
application.solution: B。解析：根据线索找隐藏奖品是 treasure hunt（寻宝游戏）。

grammar: n. 电梯；搭便车；v. 举起；抬起。英式英语中 lift 常指电梯，美式英语常用 elevator。
collocations: take the lift; give sb a lift; lift a box
commonMistake: lift 的词义看语境：take the lift 是乘电梯，give sb a lift 是开车捎某人。

example.english: We took the lift to the eighth floor.
example.chinese: 我们乘电梯到了八楼。

application.prompt: My bag is heavy. Could you help me ___ it? A. lift B. invite
application.solution: A。解析：help me 后用动词原形 lift，表示“帮我抬”。

grammar: phr. 开车顺便送某人；让某人搭便车。结构 give sb a lift 或 give a lift to sb。
collocations: give me a lift home; give a neighbour a lift; ask for a lift
commonMistake: lift 在此是名词“搭便车”；也可说 give a lift to sb。

example.english: My uncle gave me a lift to the station.
example.chinese: 我叔叔开车顺便把我送到了车站。

application.prompt: The bus has stopped running, so Dad will ___ us home. A. take notes for B. give a lift to
application.solution: B。解析：开车送某人一程可说 give sb a lift。

grammar: prep./conj. 到……时；直到……为止。作介词后接时间点或名词；作连词后接从句。
collocations: until noon; wait until Friday; stay until the shop closes
commonMistake: 主句为肯定句时常表示动作持续到某时；not ... until 表示“直到……才”。

example.english: The shop stays open until nine tonight.
example.chinese: 这家商店今晚营业到九点。

application.prompt: We waited ___ the rain stopped. A. until B. during
application.solution: A。解析：until 可引导时间状语从句，表示一直等到雨停。

grammar: phr. 小心；当心（处理某物）。with 后接需要小心对待的人或物；be careful to do sth 表示做事谨慎。
collocations: be careful with glass; be careful with money; be careful with the scissors
commonMistake: be careful with 后接名词；提醒做某事要小心可说 be careful to do。

example.english: Be careful with the hot soup.
example.chinese: 小心这碗热汤。

application.prompt: The vase is very old. Please ___ it. A. be familiar to B. be careful with
application.solution: B。解析：提醒小心处理花瓶用 be careful with it。

grammar: n. 电影。可数，复数 movies；movie 常用于美式英语，英式英语常用 film。
collocations: watch a movie; a movie ticket; a movie star
commonMistake: movie 是可数名词，单数前用 a/the；“看电影”可说 watch/see a movie。

example.english: We watched a movie together after dinner.
example.chinese: 晚饭后我们一起看了一部电影。

application.prompt: Let's watch ___ at home tonight. A. a movie B. a luggage
application.solution: A。解析：movie 是可数名词，可说 a movie。

examTags: 熟词多义·电影院与电影
grammar: phr. 去电影院；电影（行业）。go to the movies 表示去看电影，常用复数形式。
collocations: go to the movies; a night at the movies; the movie industry; the film industry
commonMistake: go to the movies 指去电影院看电影；movie 本身是“电影”，两者语义不同。

example.english: We went to the movies on Saturday evening.
example.chinese: 周六晚上我们去电影院看了电影。

application.prompt: They bought tickets and went ___ after dinner. A. to the luggage B. to the movies
application.solution: B。解析：买票去看电影可说 go to the movies。

examTags: 熟词多义·死亡与停止运行
grammar: adj. 死的；不运行的；失效的。常用 be dead、a dead battery；名词 death，副词形容词派生 deadly。
collocations: a dead battery; be dead; a dead phone
commonMistake: dead 是形容词，不能直接作动词表示“死”；“死亡”名词为 death。

example.english: My phone is dead, so I need to charge it.
example.chinese: 我的手机没电了，所以需要充电。

application.prompt: The screen is black and the battery has no power. The phone is ___. A. dead B. alive
application.solution: A。解析：dead 可表示设备停止工作或没电。

grammar: n. 笔记；便条；注意；v. 注意到；指出。常见 take a note of sth、make a note。
collocations: write a note; leave a note; note the difference
commonMistake: note 作“笔记”可数；take notes（做笔记）通常用复数。

example.english: I left a note on the kitchen table.
example.chinese: 我在厨房桌上留了一张便条。

application.prompt: The teacher asked us to ___ the new words in class. A. decorate B. note
application.solution: B。解析：注意或记下新单词可用 note；也可说 take notes。

grammar: phr. 做笔记。notes 常用复数；take 为动词，过去式 took。
collocations: take notes in class; take notes on a talk; take careful notes
commonMistake: 表示做笔记通常用 take notes；不要说 take a note 表示系统地记课堂笔记。

example.english: Students took notes during the museum talk.
example.chinese: 学生们在博物馆讲解期间做了笔记。

application.prompt: Please ___ while the guide explains the history. A. take notes B. make luggage
application.solution: A。解析：听讲解并记录信息用 take notes。

grammar: phr. 清理；打扫干净。可及物或不及物；代词宾语置于 clean 与 up 之间。
collocations: clean up the kitchen; clean it up; clean up after dinner
commonMistake: 宾语是代词时用 clean it up，不说 clean up it。

example.english: We cleaned up the room before our guests arrived.
example.chinese: 客人到来前我们打扫了房间。

application.prompt: The floor is dirty. Let's ___ before the visitors arrive. A. clean up it B. clean it up
application.solution: B。解析：短语动词接代词作宾语时，代词放中间。

grammar: n. 社区；社团；群体。可数，复数 communities；y 变 i 加 -es。
collocations: a local community; community centre; community members
commonMistake: community 的复数为 communities；不要直接写 communitys。

example.english: The local community organized a clean-up day.
example.chinese: 当地社区组织了一次清洁日活动。

application.prompt: People living in the same area can form a ___. A. community B. balcony
application.solution: A。解析：同一地区的人们组成一个 community（社区）。

examTags: 熟词多义·垃圾与无意义的话
grammar: n. 垃圾；废话，通常不可数。英式英语常用 rubbish，美式英语常用 trash/garbage。
collocations: a pile of rubbish; throw rubbish away; rubbish bin
commonMistake: rubbish 通常不可数，不说 a rubbish；一件垃圾可说 a piece of rubbish。

example.english: Please put the rubbish in the bin after lunch.
example.chinese: 午饭后请把垃圾放进垃圾桶。

application.prompt: The park is clean because visitors don't leave ___ behind. A. rubbishes B. rubbish
application.solution: B。解析：rubbish 通常作不可数名词，不加复数词尾。

grammar: adv. 差不多；几乎。可修饰动词、数词或 all/every 等词；不直接修饰名词。
collocations: almost finished; almost all the guests; almost two hours
commonMistake: almost 不直接放在名词前；表示“几乎所有的学生”说 almost all the students。

example.english: We almost missed the last metro.
example.chinese: 我们差点错过末班地铁。

application.prompt: ___ everyone arrived before the film started. A. Almost B. Most of
application.solution: A。解析：almost 可直接修饰 everyone，表示“几乎每个人”。

grammar: n. 旅行；行程；历程。可数；v. 旅行（较少用）。常指从一地到另一地的过程。
collocations: a long journey; the journey home; make a journey
commonMistake: journey 强调路程或旅行过程；trip 常指一次短期出行或游览。

example.english: The train journey from the city took two hours.
example.chinese: 从城里乘火车过去要两个小时。

application.prompt: The long train ___ was comfortable and relaxing. A. plate B. journey
application.solution: B。解析：乘火车从一地到另一地的行程是 journey。

grammar: v. 拉；拖；拽；n. 拉；拽。pull—pulled—pulled；与 push（推）相对。
collocations: pull the door open; pull a suitcase; pull a chair closer
commonMistake: pull 是“拉”，push 是“推”；规则变化加 -ed：pulled。

example.english: She pulled her suitcase across the station.
example.chinese: 她拖着行李箱穿过车站。

application.prompt: The door says “PULL,” so you should ___ it toward you. A. pull B. push
application.solution: A。解析：PULL 表示“拉”，朝自己方向拉门。

grammar: n. 行李，通常不可数。可用 a piece of luggage 表示一件行李；英式英语常用 luggage，美式英语也常用 baggage。
collocations: a piece of luggage; carry luggage; luggage rack
commonMistake: luggage 不加 -s 表复数；说“很多行李”用 a lot of luggage。

example.english: We left our luggage at the hotel before exploring the town.
example.chinese: 我们把行李放在旅馆后去逛小镇。

application.prompt: There is too much ___ to fit in the small car. A. luggages B. luggage
application.solution: B。解析：luggage 是不可数名词，不加复数 -s。

examTags: 语言运用·表达惊讶与领悟
grammar: interj. 啊；哦，用于表达高兴、惊奇、领悟等。独立使用时常以逗号或感叹号与句子分开。
collocations: Ah, I see.; Ah, that's wonderful!; Ah, now I remember.
commonMistake: ah 是感叹词，语气依语境而变；句中通常用逗号隔开，句末可用感叹号。

example.english: Ah, now I understand how the game works.
example.chinese: 啊，现在我明白这个游戏怎么玩了。

application.prompt: You suddenly remember where you left your keys. You say, “___, they're in my bag!” A. Ah B. Yet
application.solution: A。解析：Ah 可用于表示想起或领悟。

grammar: phr. 与某人分享某物。结构 share A with B；A 可为信息、食物、经历或观点。
collocations: share a room with sb; share a photo with friends; share ideas with the class
commonMistake: 表示“和某人分享某物”用 share A with B；不要说 share sth to sb。

example.english: She shared her travel photos with her classmates.
example.chinese: 她和同学们分享了旅行照片。

application.prompt: I want to ___ my plan ___ my family. A. share; to B. share; with
application.solution: B。解析：固定结构为 share A with B。

grammar: interj. 嗯；唔，可表示喜欢、同意或思考。拼写和语气由上下文决定，正式写作中少用。
collocations: Mm, that's good.; Mm, let me think.; Mm-hmm, I agree.
commonMistake: mm 是非正式感叹词，常用于对话；理解语气需结合说话情境。

example.english: Mm, this biscuit tastes really good.
example.chinese: 嗯，这块饼干真好吃。

application.prompt: After tasting the cake, Leo smiles and says, “___, delicious!” A. Mm B. Until
application.solution: A。解析：Mm 可用来表达喜欢食物的赞许语气。

grammar: adj. 熟悉的；常见的。be familiar with sth 表示熟悉某事物；be familiar to sb 表示为某人所熟悉。
collocations: be familiar with the area; a familiar face; sound familiar
commonMistake: 主语“熟悉”某物用 familiar with；某物“为某人所熟悉”用 familiar to。

example.english: Are you familiar with this part of town?
example.chinese: 你熟悉镇上的这片区域吗？

application.prompt: The guide knows every street here. She is familiar ___ the area. A. to B. with
application.solution: B。解析：表示某人熟悉某地用 be familiar with。

grammar: n. 笑话；玩笑；v. 开玩笑。可数，复数 jokes；常用 tell a joke、joke with sb。
collocations: tell a joke; make a joke about sth; joke with a friend
commonMistake: 说“讲笑话”用 tell a joke；make fun of sb 有取笑之意，不等同于 joke with sb。

example.english: He told a funny joke at the party.
example.chinese: 他在聚会上讲了一个有趣的笑话。

application.prompt: The story made everyone laugh. It was a funny ___. A. joke B. journey
application.solution: A。解析：让人发笑的小故事是 joke（笑话）。

grammar: det./pron. 几个；一些。修饰或代替可数名词复数；通常表示数量不多但超过两个。
collocations: several days; several people; several of my friends
commonMistake: several 后接可数名词复数；不能修饰不可数名词。

example.english: We visited several museums during the trip.
example.chinese: 旅行期间我们参观了几家博物馆。

application.prompt: She packed ___ books for the journey. A. much B. several
application.solution: B。解析：books 是可数名词复数，可用 several 修饰。

grammar: v. 点头；n. 点头。过去式、过去分词 nodded；现在分词 nodding，末尾辅音字母双写。
collocations: nod your head; nod in agreement; give a nod
commonMistake: nod 变过去式或现在分词时双写 d：nodded、nodding。

example.english: He nodded when he understood the directions.
example.chinese: 他听懂路线说明后点了点头。

application.prompt: She ___ her head to show that she agreed. A. nodded B. noded
application.solution: A。解析：nod 的过去式要双写 d 再加 -ed。

grammar: n. 作者；作家。由 write + -er 构成；writer 指写书、文章等的人。
collocations: a travel writer; a famous writer; a writer of children's books
commonMistake: writer 是“作者/作家”；write 是动词“写”，注意词性变化。

example.english: The writer described the town in great detail.
example.chinese: 作者详细描写了这座小镇。

application.prompt: The person who wrote this travel guide is its ___. A. reader B. writer
application.solution: B。解析：写作或编写指南的人是 writer。

grammar: n. 正文；文本；v. 用手机给某人发短信。过去式 texted；常用 text sb / text sb sth。
collocations: the main text; a text message; text a friend
commonMistake: text 作动词可直接接人：text me；发短信给某人不说 text to me。

example.english: I'll text you when we arrive at the hotel.
example.chinese: 我们到旅馆时会给你发短信。

application.prompt: The map is missing. Please ___ me the address. A. text B. cover
application.solution: A。解析：text 可作动词，表示用手机给某人发信息。

grammar: v. 描述；形容。后接人或事物作宾语，也可用 describe sth as...；名词 description。
collocations: describe a place; describe the problem; describe sth as beautiful
commonMistake: describe 后直接接描述对象，不说 describe about sth；名词形式为 description。

example.english: Can you describe the apartment to me?
example.chinese: 你能给我描述一下这套公寓吗？

application.prompt: Please ___ what the room looks like. A. borrow B. describe
application.solution: B。解析：说明房间的样子用 describe（描述）。

grammar: adv./conj. 无论去哪里；在任何地方。可引导地点状语从句，常表示地点不受限制。
collocations: wherever you go; sit wherever you like; take it wherever you travel
commonMistake: wherever 引导从句时，通常不用再加 there；主句表达结果或建议。

example.english: Wherever we travel, we try the local food.
example.chinese: 无论去哪里旅行，我们都会尝尝当地食物。

application.prompt: You can put your suitcase ___ you find space. A. wherever B. until
application.solution: A。解析：wherever 表示“在任何有空间的地方”。

grammar: v. 要紧；有关系；n. 事情；问题。常见 What matters is...；What's the matter?
collocations: It doesn't matter; a serious matter; What's the matter?
commonMistake: matter 作动词时意为“重要/要紧”；What's the matter? 是询问“怎么了”。

example.english: It doesn't matter if we arrive a little late.
example.chinese: 我们晚到一会儿也没关系。

application.prompt: “___?” “I can't find my invitation.” A. What time is it B. What's the matter
application.solution: B。解析：询问对方怎么了用 What's the matter?

grammar: phr. 不论；不要紧。no matter + 疑问词可引导让步状语从句，如 no matter where/what。
collocations: no matter what; no matter where you go; no matter how hard
commonMistake: no matter 后接疑问词和完整从句；不要漏掉从句中的主语或谓语。

example.english: No matter where we stay, we can take the metro.
example.chinese: 无论我们住在哪里，都可以乘地铁。

application.prompt: ___ what happens, call me when you arrive. A. No matter B. Because
application.solution: A。解析：no matter what 表示“无论发生什么”。

grammar: adv. 也许；可能。常置于句首或情态动词前后；语气比 certainly 不确定。
collocations: perhaps later; perhaps we should wait; perhaps the best choice
commonMistake: perhaps 是副词，不单独充当谓语；常与 may/might 所表达的可能性搭配。

example.english: Perhaps we can visit the market tomorrow.
example.chinese: 也许我们明天可以去逛市场。

application.prompt: ___ we should ask the guide for directions. A. Nearly B. Perhaps
application.solution: B。解析：提出不确定的建议可用 perhaps（也许）。

examTags: 熟词多义·盘子与金属板
grammar: n. 盘子；碟子；金属板。可数，复数 plates；a plate of food 表示一盘食物。
collocations: a dinner plate; a plate of rice; wash the plates
commonMistake: plate 是容器“盘子”；一盘某种食物用 a plate of + 食物。

example.english: He put a plate of biscuits on the table.
example.chinese: 他把一盘饼干放在桌上。

application.prompt: Please put the sandwiches on a clean ___. A. plate B. towel
application.solution: A。解析：盛放三明治可用 plate（盘子）。

grammar: adv. 刚刚；新近。由 fresh + -ly 构成，常修饰过去分词或形容词。
collocations: freshly made; freshly painted; freshly baked bread
commonMistake: freshly 修饰“刚刚制作/烘焙”的动作结果；fresh 是形容词，不能直接修饰动词。

example.english: We ate freshly baked bread for breakfast.
example.chinese: 早餐我们吃了刚烤好的面包。

application.prompt: The ___ painted room still smells of paint. A. fresh B. freshly
application.solution: B。解析：修饰过去分词 painted，用副词 freshly。

grammar: v. 闻到；闻起来；n. 气味。smell—smelled/smelt—smelled/smelt；感官动词可接形容词作表语。
collocations: smell the flowers; smell sweet; a strange smell
commonMistake: smell + 形容词表示“闻起来……”；不要误用副词修饰系动词 smell。

example.english: The soup smells wonderful, but it needs more salt.
example.chinese: 汤闻起来很香，不过还需要再加点盐。

application.prompt: The freshly baked biscuits ___ delicious. A. smell B. are smelling
application.solution: A。解析：smell 表示感官状态时常用一般现在时，后接形容词。

grammar: n. 喜悦；乐趣。通常不可数；joyful 为形容词；可说 bring sb joy、a joy to do sth。
collocations: with joy; bring joy to sb; the joy of travel
commonMistake: joy 通常不可数；“令人愉快的”用 joyful，joyous 也可作形容词。

example.english: The visit brought great joy to the children.
example.chinese: 这次参观给孩子们带来了许多快乐。

application.prompt: The good news filled her with ___. A. joyful B. joy
application.solution: B。解析：介词 with 后用名词 joy；joyful 是形容词。

grammar: n. 公寓套房。可数；美式英语常用 apartment，英式英语常用 flat。
collocations: rent an apartment; an apartment building; a two-bedroom apartment
commonMistake: apartment 指一套公寓住房；不要与 department（部门）混淆拼写。

example.english: They rented an apartment near the university.
example.chinese: 他们在大学附近租了一套公寓。

application.prompt: The family lives in a two-bedroom ___. A. apartment B. community
application.solution: A。解析：两卧室的住房可称为 a two-bedroom apartment。

grammar: n. 大楼；街区；大块；v. 阻挡；堵塞。可数，复数 blocks；block A from doing sth。
collocations: a block of flats; a block of ice; block the road
commonMistake: block 可指街区、大楼或块状物；动词 block 后直接接被阻挡对象。

example.english: The new apartment block is three streets from the station.
example.chinese: 这栋新公寓楼离车站有三个街区。

application.prompt: A fallen tree may ___ the road after the storm. A. describe B. block
application.solution: B。解析：树倒在路上会阻挡交通，可用动词 block。

grammar: v. 装饰；装潢。decorate sth with sth；过去式 decorated；名词 decoration。
collocations: decorate a room; decorate the tree with lights; decorate a cake
commonMistake: 表示“用某物装饰”用 decorate A with B；不要把 with 后的装饰物和被装饰对象次序颠倒。

example.english: They decorated the living room with paper flowers.
example.chinese: 他们用纸花装饰了客厅。

application.prompt: We decorated the poster ___ colourful pictures. A. with B. from
application.solution: A。解析：decorate sth with sth 表示“用……装饰……”。

grammar: v. 遮盖；覆盖；包括；报道；n. 覆盖物；封面。cover A with B 表示用 B 覆盖 A。
collocations: cover the table; cover a book; cover the cost
commonMistake: cover A with B 是“用 B 覆盖 A”；be covered with 表示“被……覆盖”。

example.english: She covered the bowl with a clean plate.
example.chinese: 她用一个干净的盘子盖住了碗。

application.prompt: The guidebook ___ all the main sights in town. A. borrows B. covers
application.solution: B。解析：cover 可表示“包括、涉及”，此处指指南涵盖所有主要景点。

grammar: n. 海报；招贴。可数，复数 posters；通常张贴在墙面或公告板上。
collocations: a travel poster; put up a poster; a poster for the film
commonMistake: poster 是可数名词，单数前用 a/the；动词“张贴”常用 put up。

example.english: We made a poster for the school trip.
example.chinese: 我们为学校旅行做了一张海报。

application.prompt: The club put up a ___ to invite students to the event. A. poster B. luggage
application.solution: A。解析：宣传活动常用 poster（海报）。

grammar: n. 剪刀，通常以复数形式出现。a pair of scissors 表示一把剪刀，谓语通常与 pair 一致。
collocations: a pair of scissors; sharp scissors; cut paper with scissors
commonMistake: scissors 形式上是复数；“一把剪刀”说 a pair of scissors，不说 a scissor。

example.english: I need a pair of scissors to cut the paper.
example.chinese: 我需要一把剪刀来剪纸。

application.prompt: This pair of scissors ___ very sharp. A. are B. is
application.solution: B。解析：中心词是单数 pair，谓语用 is。

grammar: n. 胶水，通常不可数；v. 粘贴；胶合。过去式 glued；glue A to B 表示把 A 粘到 B 上。
collocations: a bottle of glue; glue paper together; glue a label to a box
commonMistake: 表示胶水时 glue 通常不可数；“一瓶胶水”用 a bottle of glue。

example.english: Use a little glue to attach the picture to the card.
example.chinese: 用一点胶水把图片粘到卡片上。

application.prompt: We used ___ to stick the paper shapes together. A. glue B. glues
application.solution: A。解析：表示材料“胶水”时 glue 通常不可数。

grammar: n. 剪纸。可数，复数 paper-cuts；作定语时 paper-cut 常修饰 art/design。
collocations: Chinese paper-cut; paper-cut art; make a paper-cut
commonMistake: paper-cut 作“剪纸作品”时可数；表示剪纸艺术可说 paper-cut art。

example.english: The museum displayed a beautiful paper-cut of a flower.
example.chinese: 博物馆展出了一幅漂亮的花朵剪纸。

application.prompt: This traditional picture is made by cutting paper with scissors. It is a ___. A. text B. paper-cut
application.solution: B。解析：通过剪纸制成的传统图案是 paper-cut。
